purpose: The load and test order for the W-A repeatability check, DECLARED BEFORE the streak ran, per the owner ruling recorded at assignment §1 (D-P3-9) and the record §6.5(2). This file is the declaration; the streak outputs are `wa-streak-w7.json` and `wa-streak-p2b.json` beside it. The declaration was committed before the first streak run and is not edited afterwards.
declaredAtCommit: declared by the Phase 3 W-A commit that first carries this file; the streaks were started after that commit existed
caseIds: tests/system/udg-003-phase-2/runtime.test.ts > UDG-003 Phase 2 runtime — the population and the recovery scenarios > P-2b, reopened for the harness only, exercises GA-6a, GA-6b, GA-6c and GA-7 at the declared test values

tests/system/udg-003-phase-2/runtime.test.ts > UDG-003 Phase 2 runtime — the population and the recovery scenarios > W-7: the 4000 ms episode deadline expires with no fresh snapshot, and the three limits stay distinct

testOrder.declaration: the full `pnpm test` order as resolved by the pinned `vitest.config.ts` — `fileParallelism: false`, `maxWorkers: 1`, include `tests/**/*.test.ts` — with the two affected cases running inside it, never isolated
testOrder.whyTheWholeFileOrder: the contention under test is the suite's own serial execution: the probe writes the artefact the two cases read, and the accepted harness is polled while the rest of the suite competes for the same event loop. Isolating the two cases would remove the environment that the hosted failures arrived in.

load.declaration: four busy-spinner Node processes (tests/system/udg-003-phase-3/wa-streak.ts generates them; each spins on Math.sqrt until killed) run alongside every streak iteration
load.why: the hosted job runs on a shared 4-vCPU runner and the failures arrived while the job was heavy. Four spinners on the implementer's 18-core container reproduce sustained scheduling pressure on the single-threaded probe without invalidating the measurement environment.

machineClass.nodeVersion: v24.22.3 (the implementer container; the repository pins 24.22.2 and the authoritative first-attempt hosted run executes on the pinned toolchain)
machineClass.note: declared honestly: this is not the pinned Node and not the runner's core count, which is why the rule is ten local passes AND a first-attempt hosted green on the exact submitted commit

load.saturationProfileReportedSeparately: an environment-saturated profile (one spinner per core, 18/18) is reported as defect WA-3 in the W-A diagnosis record: it flips the impairment probe's own environment controls and is disclosed as environment-invalidating, not as the declared streak load. A streak run in an environment the probe itself declares invalid would be a green that means nothing.

rule.perDefect: W-7 and P-2b are scored separately, from the same iterations; a red attributable to either defect restarts that defect's streak, and the red is retained in the iteration log
rule.hosted: a first-attempt green hosted run on the exact submitted commit is required in addition to the ten passes
rule.reproducerOrControl: each defect additionally needs a targeted reproducer or a failing control (tests/system/udg-003-phase-3/wa-assertion-audit.ts is the control that makes a claimed assertion failure falsifiable per assertion); where an original failure cannot be reproduced, the record publishes what the retained evidence establishes before proposing any change

preservedUnchanged.statement: the deadlines, the retry limits, the close codes, the three-limit discrimination map and every accepted assertion are preserved; any change that would move one of them is out of grant G-P3-2
